summary: Tested two new features: shareable public profiles (/u/:username) and auto-accept policy for extension scans. All 15 backend pytest tests pass (8 new) and all frontend flows verified (Settings sections, toggles, public link copy box, public profile rendering when public, 404 when private).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~782 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; should be split into routers/auth.py, routers/public.py, routers/extension.py.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI 0.110+ — switch to lifespan context manager.
PATCH /api/auth/settings allows empty-string name silently ignored (treated as no-update for that field) — OK but worth documenting; current behavior strips trailing spaces and caps at 60 chars.

slugify_username collapses every disallowed character including spaces; a username like 'Admin User' becomes 'admin-user' which is fine, but inputs of only invalid chars fall back to 'user' — consider a clearer 400 error for clarity.
Public profile GET returns plain 404 for both 'user not found' and 'profile private' — intentional for privacy, good.

Auto-accept path inserts a suggestion doc and then immediately marks it accepted; an alternate optimization would be to skip the suggestion document entirely, but current behavior keeps an audit trail (acceptable).
PublicProfile.jsx fetches via axios.get without credentials — correct for public endpoint; does not leak auth.

PublicProfile theme effect: 'prev' captured at mount is reverted on unmount — works, but the cleanup runs before the second effect re-applies if username changes; OK because there's no nested race here.
test_credentials: admin@hanabi.app / hanabi123 (verified). Admin ends test run with profile_public=true and auto_accept=true.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient users (test_*@example.com), one TEST_Public_* title (cleaned up), an Itaewon Class scan title (cleaned up), and two API keys (revoked). No residual production-affecting data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features fully working. Backend testids/data-testids confirmed: settings-name, settings-username, save-profile, toggle-public, toggle-autoaccept, public-link, copy-public-link, public-categories, public-cat-{slug}, public-title-{id}. Shadcn Switch reports state via attribute data-state=checked|unchecked — use that for assertions. Frontend route /u/:username is the only unauthenticated app route besides /login and /register. Existing apikey/suggestion flow test was patched to disable auto_accept first (since admin defaults to auto_accept=true now).
rca of the issue: n/a — one initial failure in test_apikey_extension_suggestion_flow (existing iteration-1 test) because admin now has auto_accept=true, so /extension/scan no longer creates a pending suggestion. Fixed the legacy test to toggle auto_accept off before running (this is test maintenance, not a product bug).
